name: cyclopts-source-located-configuration-diagnostics
instr:
Cyclopts cannot report every configuration problem with source locations in one validation result. Add inspectable diagnostics without executing commands, with equivalent detail during ordinary parsing.

Each JSON, TOML, or YAML load exposes its parsed mapping, source label, and grammar-derived locations for existing nested dictionary or sequence paths. Preserve format semantics, aliases, merged mappings, empty documents, loader failures, dotted keys, arrays of tables, and parent-discovered files. Preserve leaf locations through command scoping, flattening, conversion, and validation.

Diagnostics carry severity, stable message, source, nested path, and any available location. Reports preserve source application order and are successful exactly when they contain no error diagnostic. Accumulate independent attributable failures without invoking the command or suppressing later failures.

Keep CLI and environment precedence authoritative. Do not diagnose shadowed unused or sibling command configuration. Refresh cached values and locations together when the selected file changes.

Preserve malformed-document exception types, rendering, and causes, plus ordinary conversion-error rendering and metadata. Configuration-caused parsing failures expose equivalent details through `config_report`; CLI-only failures leave it absent. `App.validate_config` returns `ConfigReport` for the selected command without execution.
